FAQ

Good to know.

FAQ ↗
What is a Litbuy spreadsheet?+

It helps you discover and organize products and links before ordering through Litbuy.

Where can I see QC photos?+

Check available images on the product and platform pages. Direct QC integration is still being verified.

Is this the official Litbuy site?+

No. This is an independent product-discovery preview. Litbuy handles purchases and accounts.

What is a Litbuy spreadsheet?+

A Litbuy spreadsheet is a way to discover and organize product finds and links before reviewing the listing on a shopping platform. This site uses a historical FindSpreadsheet catalog snapshot.

How do I search for Litbuy finds?+

Use the search box to look for a product name, available translated title, category or Weidian number. Select the camera for image search; its results are approximate and open in this site’s product list.

How do I buy a Weidian product through Litbuy?+

Open a product here, select the Litbuy purchase button, and confirm the item number, options, current price and availability on Litbuy before placing an order.

Are the displayed prices final?+

No. The preview uses historical CNY prices converted into estimated USD values. Product prices, exchange rates, domestic delivery, service charges, international shipping and taxes can change. Confirm the current total on Litbuy.

Where are the QC photos?+

QC photos are inspection images associated with an item. This preview cannot currently load the FindSpreadsheet QC feed directly. Check the source page and your Litbuy warehouse account for available photos; ordinary seller images are not necessarily QC photos.

What should I check in QC photos?+

Compare the item with your chosen option and look for visible damage, labels, colour, stitching and measurements where available. Photos alone do not guarantee authenticity, fit or quality. Contact the platform before shipping if anything looks wrong.

How does Litbuy warehouse storage work?+

Litbuy describes warehouse storage and parcel consolidation in its help center. Storage terms and fees can change, so check the current dates and rules in your own account.

How much does international shipping cost?+

Shipping depends on destination, packed weight and dimensions, route, restrictions and any optional services. Use Litbuy’s current estimator and review the final charge before submitting a parcel.

What if a Weidian link or product is unavailable?+

Seller listings can change or disappear. Recheck the original item number and current availability, then search for an alternative. Do not assume a historical price or listing is still valid.

Can I use other buying agents?+

The product page includes an expandable list of available platforms for items with valid Weidian numbers. Check each platform’s current price, fees and terms before ordering.

Is Litbuy Sheet Lab the official Litbuy website?+

No. This is an independent product-discovery preview. Litbuy handles its own accounts, purchasing, warehouse services, shipping and support.

Can I search by image?+

Yes. Choose the camera beside the search box and select a JPG, PNG or WebP image under 15 MB. Results are ranked using approximate visual similarity across the indexed historical catalog; review the listing before buying.
